summary: Member virtual books now live under the persona identity on hosted too (one file per persona, surviving a RuntimeBinding replacement), carry in the exact member's marks recorded under earlier per-binding book files once, and complete from admission to the first live mark with the existing pool_admission replay on governed daily bars. Every filled row names its source; a session no source produces stays a named gap and the book stays since_inception false.

1_fill.detail: MemberVirtualBooks._fill_admission runs for a book whose first mark is later than admitted_at + ADMISSION_FIRST_MARK_GRACE_DAYS. Sessions = governed Taiwan trading days (instrument_candidates.is_trading_day) from the admission date to the day before the first live mark. Recorded views come first: marks of the same member in earlier binding files are carried in as recorded. Everything else comes only from governed_admission_replay_source: registry artifact (same reader the member baselines use, checksum must match), governed_market_dataset.resolve_governed_dataset, and services.research.pool_admission._replay (new optional rows_out argument; no second replay), close of D decided exposure filled at the open of D+1 (FILL_CONVENTION).

2_source_ref_and_gaps.detail: Filled rows carry source_ref governed-replay:<dataset snapshot id>:pool_admission._replay. A session with no source stays a gap recorded in book.admission_fill.gaps with its reason (session_not_in_governed_dataset, replay_gave_no_view_for_session, admission_replay_unavailable:<reason>, admission_replay_source_unconfigured, calendar_unavailable:...); the book reports since_inception false and since_inception_reason admission_gap_unfilled:<reasons>. Live rows are inserted-before only, never changed (asserted row for row).

3_runtime_path_once_idempotent.detail: paper_runtime builds MemberVirtualBooks with the governed replay source and legacy paths; the fill runs inside _observe on the signal path, no manual hosted write. admission_fill is stored on the book, carried with it across restart, envelope and binding replacement, so it runs once; a fill that left gaps is retried at most once per process and adds only missing sessions (test_fill_runs_once_and_is_idempotent..., test_gap_from_an_unavailable_source_is_filled_once_the_source_returns...).

4_runtime_budget.detail: One-time write of at most one row per member per governed session between admission and the first live mark (8 sessions 2026-11-09..2026-11-18 for each of the 3 hosted members). Afterwards one row per member per session. One book file per persona (member-books/<sha256(tenant, persona)>.json) instead of one per binding; no new file type. Registry read and dataset build once per (member, checksum) per process.

5_tests.detail: test_hosted_book_is_filled_from_admission_with_the_governed_replay_and_reweight_accepts_it uses the hosted shape (admitted 2026-11-08T18:10:02Z, four marks 2026-11-19..2026-11-24, admitted_at null) and governed-shaped daily bars; pool_policy.reweight accepts the filled book. On current dev MemberVirtualBooks has no history_source and no fill, so the book is since_inception false and reweight raises virtual_book_high_water_history_missing (the pre-existing test_hosted_late_book_records_admission_but_stays_not_since_inception in test_pool_policy.py keeps asserting exactly that for a book without a fill source, unchanged).

6_probe.detail: acceptance/probes/persona-member-book-admission also fails (book_not_since_inception:<ref>:reason=<since_inception_reason>) when a current member book with a mark newer than the BFF build time is since_inception false.

changed_assertions.justification: The same hosted-shape book has since_inception false, which the probe now also reports after the admission failure; the original admitted_at_not_joined_at entry is still asserted, first.

The passing book must now also be since_inception true (new probe rule); the detail helper takes since_inception and this case sets true. A new test covers the same book with since_inception false failing.

book_continuity.root_cause: paper_fleet_reconciler sets PANTHEON_PERFORMANCE_STATE_PATH per binding, so paper_runtime put the books at <binding state>.lifecycle-outbox.json.member-books.json and the persona-scoped path was used only when no path was configured, which never happens on hosted.
book_continuity.change: paper_runtime uses the persona-scoped member-books/<sha256(tenant, persona)>.json whenever the lifecycle path is not explicitly configured and a persona id exists, including with PANTHEON_PERFORMANCE_STATE_PATH set.
book_continuity.carry_in: Earlier per-binding files (*.member-books.json in the same directory) are read once, lazily, when a book key is new and the persona store holds no matching book. Only the exact member (member_id, artifact, version, checksum, symbol, underlying_count) is carried; marks are merged by event time and copied unchanged; admitted_at comes from the current member view, not from the old file. Provenance is written to book.carried_from (file names). Because books carry no persona id, a same-directory book of the identical immutable member would also match; its marks are the same deterministic views of the same artifact and bars, and the admission time never comes from it.
book_continuity.old_files: Old binding files (31 rb-*.json bindings and their .lifecycle-outbox.json.member-books.json files under /data/runtime/paper-performance as of 2026-11-26) are read only, never moved, rewritten or deleted by this change (asserted byte for byte in test_runtime_book_survives_a_binding_replacement_with_the_reconcilers_state_path). The names actually carried are recorded per book in carried_from after the release runs; no hosted access was used to list them here.
book_continuity.reconciler_note: paper_fleet_reconciler's retired-binding sweep deletes <binding>.member-books.json; it never touches member-books/, so persona books survive binding retirement.

tests.not_covered: The governed store read itself (pyarrow DailyBarsReader) is not exercised: the worker interpreter has no pyarrow. The fill tests inject the dataset resolver with a dataset of the exact shape governed_market_dataset serves; governed_market_dataset keeps its own store tests.

known_limits_and_follow_up: DEPLOYMENT DEPENDENCY: the runtime workers run in the paper-fleet-reconciler image, whose lock (dependencies/locks/services-paper_fleet_reconciler.txt) has no pyarrow, so governed_market_dataset raises daily_bars_reader_unavailable there. Until the image carries pyarrow (or another governed bar reader is wired), hosted books record named gaps (admission_gap_unfilled:admission_replay_unavailable:daily_bars_reader_unavailable), stay since_inception false and the probe fails honestly; nothing is invented. The lock file is outside this task's declared artifacts, so it is a separate follow-up task. The fill retries once per process, so it completes after the image change without a manual write.
The runtime worker needs /data/source-ingest mounted read-only at the default GOVERNED_MARKET_STORE_ROOT (/data/source-ingest/market_data_store); the reconciler service already mounts it.
Members whose artifact uses target positions have no per-symbol replay views; their sessions stay gaps (replay_gave_no_view_for_session or the replay error).
Hosted proof (reweight accepted after the next marks, probe green) happens after release and is not claimed here.
